summary: Acer Aspire 5 15 (Exact Model: A515-57G-R0JF) has been experiencing thermal throttling issues due to inadequate cooling system. The laptop's failure mode is characterized by CPU and GPU temperatures exceeding safe limits, leading to performance degradation and potential damage.
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling due to inadequate cooling system
suggested_solution: Update BIOS to latest version (F.20), install high-performance cooling solution, upgrade cooling fans and consider replacing Intel HD Graphics 620 with more powerful GPU.
